import json
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
import unittest

class HookContract(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_registered_edit_modes(self):
        config = json.loads(Path(".codex/hooks.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        for event, mode in (("PreToolUse", "before-edit"), ("PostToolUse", "after-edit")):
            commands = [handler["command"] for group in config["hooks"].get(event, [])
                        for handler in group["hooks"]]
            self.assertTrue(any("check-java.py" in command and mode in command for command in commands), event)

    def test_git_candidate_without_backend(self):
        checker = Path("scripts/check-java.py")
        self.assertTrue(checker.is_file(), "Java candidate needs an entry point")
        result = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-B", "-X", "utf8", str(checker), "--candidate", "index"],
                                capture_output=True, text=True, encoding="utf-8")
        self.assertEqual(0, result.returncode, result.stderr)
        self.assertEqual("not-applicable", json.loads(result.stdout)["status"])

    def test_java_and_existing_hook_regressions(self):
        self.assertTrue(Path("scripts/check-java.py").is_file(), "Java hook must support the regression fixtures")
        for filename, filter_args in (
            ("test_java_hooks.py", []),
            ("test_harness_inventory.py", ["-k", "real_commit_runs_old_hook_then_rejects_or_accepts_candidate"]),
        ):
            result = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-B", "-X", "utf8", "-m", "unittest", "discover", "-s", "scripts/tests",
                                     "-p", filename, *filter_args], capture_output=True, text=True, encoding="utf-8")
            self.assertEqual(0, result.returncode, result.stdout + result.stderr)

suite = unittest.defaultTestLoader.loadTestsFromTestCase(HookContract)
names = [test.id() for test in suite]
result = unittest.TextTestRunner().run(suite)
Path(sys.argv[1]).write_text(json.dumps({
    "runId": sys.argv[2], "tests": result.testsRun, "failures": len(result.failures),
    "errors": len(result.errors), "skipped": len(result.skipped), "names": names,
    "failedNames": [test.id() for test, _ in result.failures],
}), encoding="utf-8")
sys.exit(not result.wasSuccessful())
